inputFields.name: standaloneRepo
inputFields.description: Generate as a standalone Git repository
inputFields.helpText: y: a self-contained Maven project with its own pom, README, release workflow and a local Git repository ready to push. n: a bp-* module for the chenile-gen build.

inputFields.name: groupId
inputFields.description: Maven groupId of the blueprint jar

inputFields.name: githubRepository
inputFields.description: GitHub repository it will live in (owner/repo), optional
inputFields.helpText: For example acme/jgen-terraform. Used in the README and in the push instructions; nothing is pushed.

inputFields.name: super_pom
inputFields.description: Optional parent POM for the generated project
inputFields.helpText: Object with groupId, artifactId, version and relativePath. Omit to keep the blueprint parent.

inputFields.name: dependencies
inputFields.helpText: Added to bp-__blueprintName__/pom.xml. Versions may be omitted when supplied by dependency management.
